label: Free
description: Your own prompt, with optional first and last frames or references.
template: {prompt}

label: Animate
description: Brings an image to life: it becomes the first frame.

fields.label: What moves
fields.placeholder: her hair in the wind, the camera slowly pushes in

template: {motion}. Keep the image's subject, style and lighting. {prompt}

label: First & last frame
description: Starts on one image and ends on another.

fields.label: How it goes from one to the other
fields.placeholder: a smooth camera move, the light shifts to dusk

template: A continuous shot from the first frame to the last frame: {transition}. {prompt}

label: Dolly zoom in
description: Pushes in while zooming out: the background stretches, the subject holds.

fields.label: Subject
fields.placeholder: the dancer in the red coat

template: Dolly zoom (vertigo effect) on {subject}: the camera dollies in at a {speed} pace while the lens zooms out, the background stretches away and the subject stays the same size in frame. {prompt}

label: Crash zoom in
description: A sudden, fast zoom onto the subject's face.
template: Crash zoom: the camera snaps in very fast onto {subject}, with motion blur, then holds on the close-up. {prompt}

label: Earth zoom out
description: Pulls back from the subject up to orbit.

fields.label: Subject
fields.placeholder: a woman on a rooftop in Paris

template: Continuous zoom out starting close on {subject}, rising through the city, the clouds and the atmosphere until the whole Earth is seen from orbit. One unbroken move. {prompt}

label: FPV drone
description: A fast first-person drone flight through the scene.

fields.label: Flight path
fields.placeholder: dives off the cliff, skims the waves, rises over the boat

template: FPV drone shot, fast and fluid, wide lens with slight fisheye: {path}. {prompt}

label: Orbit
description: Arcs around the subject, left or right, part way or all around.
template: The camera orbits {direction} around {subject}, {arc}, at a steady distance, the subject kept centered. {prompt}

label: Handheld
description: Documentary feel: a slightly shaky camera following the action.

fields.label: Action
fields.placeholder: she walks through the market, looks back

template: Handheld camera, natural micro-shake, documentary style, following the action: {action}. {prompt}

label: Static shot
description: A locked-off camera: only the scene moves.

fields.label: What happens
fields.placeholder: steam rises from the coffee cup

template: Static locked-off camera on a tripod, no camera movement at all. {action}. {prompt}

label: Set on fire
description: Flames spread over the subject, realistic fire and smoke.
template: {subject} catches fire: realistic flames spread across it, embers and smoke rise, the light of the fire flickers on the surroundings. {prompt}

label: Disintegration
description: The subject crumbles into dust carried by the wind.
template: {subject} disintegrates into fine dust particles that drift away on the wind, starting from the edges, until nothing is left. {prompt}

label: Freeze
description: Frost spreads and the subject turns to ice.
template: Frost crystals spread over {subject} until it is frozen solid in clear ice, cold mist around it. {prompt}

label: Turn to metal
description: The subject turns into polished chrome, then melts or holds.
template: {subject} turns into liquid-polished chrome metal from head to toe, reflections sliding over it, then it {end}. {prompt}

label: Explosion
description: A cinematic explosion behind or at the subject.
template: A cinematic explosion bursts from {where}: fireball, shockwave, debris, the subject stays in frame. {prompt}

label: Talking avatar
description: A photo of a person speaks a voice: lip-synced talking head (it needs a human-like face).
template: The person speaks the audio, natural lip-sync and facial expressions, {motion}. {prompt}

label: Free edit
description: Changes what you describe in a video, the rest stays. Draw on a frame to point at it.
template: {prompt}. Change only that, keep everything else of the video identical.

label: Extend
description: Continues a video after its end (sequel) or builds what came before (prequel).
template: {next}. Same characters, place, light and camera style as the video. {prompt}

label: Upscale
description: Sharper and larger: precise keeps the original, creative adds detail.
template: {prompt}

label: Relight & atmosphere
description: Changes the time of day or the lighting, shadows follow.

fields.label: New light
fields.placeholder: golden hour, low sun from the left

template: Relight the video: {light}. Light and shadows follow the 3D scene, nothing else changes. {prompt}

label: Recolor & restyle
description: A new grade, new colors for an item, or an artistic style, motion kept.

fields.label: New look
fields.placeholder: teal and orange grade, the jacket becomes yellow

template: Restyle the video: {look}. Keep the motion, framing and timing identical. {prompt}

label: Object swap
description: Replaces a subject or object, the action stays.
template: Replace {old} with {new} (the reference image if given), keeping its position, motion and the lighting. Everything else stays identical. {prompt}

label: Clean up
description: Removes objects, wires or people you name.

fields.label: Remove
fields.placeholder: the boom mic at the top and the man in the background

template: Remove {what} from the whole video and fill the background naturally. Nothing else changes. {prompt}

label: Reframe
description: Another aspect ratio, cropped around the point you pick. Local and free.
